findings.cost: River bets in live games are value-heavy — automatic calls pay off exactly the hands that beat you.
findings.fix: Make river calls a decision, not a reflex: name the worse hands you beat before the chips go in.
findings.meaning: You call river bets with almost everything.
findings.title: Folding vs river bets

findings.cost: Peeling this wide builds big pots you often surrender later.
findings.fix: Turn calls need river plans — decide what you do on bricks and scare cards before you call.
findings.meaning: You barely fold on turns.
findings.title: Folding vs turn bets

findings.cost: Floating this often only works with a plan for later streets; otherwise it just makes the pots you lose bigger.
findings.fix: Fold the hands with no pair, no draw and no backdoors — they rarely turn into winners by the river.
findings.meaning: You continue against nearly every flop bet.
findings.title: Folding vs flop bets

findings.cost: Calling 3-bets this wide — often out of position — puts you in big pots with dominated hands. This bleeds stack even when no single hand looks like a disaster.
findings.fix: Tighten your continues: fold the weakest opens to 3-bets (offsuit broadways, weak suited hands), keep calls for pairs and strong suited hands, 4-bet premiums.
findings.meaning: When your open gets 3-bet, you almost always continue.
findings.title: Folding to 3-bets after opening

findings.cost: Defending everything means playing lots of postflop pots out of position with weak holdings.
findings.fix: Keep the wide defense only if your postflop game backs it up — drop the worst offsuit junk.
findings.meaning: You defend your big blind against nearly every steal.
findings.title: BB folds vs steals

findings.cost: High showdown rates usually mean calling down too loose — or missing chances to win pots with well-timed aggression.
findings.fix: Review your showdown losses in Session History: how many of those calls only beat bluffs?
findings.meaning: Once you see a flop, you ride the hand to showdown a lot.
findings.title: Going to showdown

findings.cost: Counter-intuitively, winning almost every showdown means you only get there with the goods — the pots you folded on the way were the expensive ones.
findings.fix: Pair this with your fold-vs-bet numbers above: the leak is usually earlier in the hand, not at showdown.
findings.meaning: You win showdowns at a very high rate.
findings.title: Winning at showdown
